snippet.title: Let It Consume - Release Date Announcement | An Incremental About Running A Cult
snippet.description:
Hey y'all! After a lot of work, I'm happy to announce that Let It Consume is releasing on Steam on April 9th!

Wishlist it here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4161970/Let_It_Consume/

Let It Consume is an incremental game where you run a dark cult and satisfy an ancient, hungry presence, featuring exciting gameplay.

It'll release at $4.99 with a 10% discount for the first 2 weeks.
